items.exampleEn: This history book has a chapter about terrorism in the last century.
items.exampleZh: 這本歷史書有一章講上個世紀的恐怖主義。

items.exampleEn: Our town council has seven members.
items.exampleZh: 我們的鎮議會有七名議員。

items.exampleEn: A bullet can travel very fast.
The students held a protest against the new school rules.
items.exampleZh: 學生們舉行抗議活動，反對新的校規。

items.exampleEn: Hotel rooms should give guests enough privacy.
items.exampleZh: 飯店房間應該給客人足夠的隱私。

items.exampleEn: Do you think the punishment was fair?

items.exampleEn: The company appointed a new manager.
items.exampleZh: 公司任命了一位新經理。

items.exampleEn: Is your new bike registered with the police?
items.exampleZh: 你的新腳踏車有在警察局登記嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Please register at the front desk first.

items.audioEn: The city council will meet on Monday to talk about the new bus lines.
items.audioZh: 市議會將在星期一開會討論新的公車路線。
items.questionZh: 市議會星期一要討論什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Privacy is important on the internet.
She was appointed team leader last week.

items.stemEn: As a ____, he had to stay after school and clean the classroom.
items.stemZh: 作為懲罰，他放學後必須留下來打掃教室。

items.stemEn: You must ____ for the summer camp before May.
items.stemZh: 夏令營必須在五月前報名。

items.passageEn: Last month, our class visited the city hall to learn how the city council works. Each of us had to register online before the visit. A council member showed us an old map of the city. She told us about a famous protest long ago: some students walked to the city hall to ask for a bigger library, and the council agreed. She also said that everyone has a right to privacy, so the city keeps people's information safe. The council works with the police to keep the city safe from crime and terrorism, too. At the end, our teacher appointed two students to write a report. My friend joked that writing a report was a punishment, but it was fun.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們班去參觀市政府，了解市議會怎麼運作。參觀前，每個人都要先上網登記。一位議員給我們看了一張城市的老地圖。她跟我們說了很久以前一場有名的抗議：一群學生走到市政府，要求蓋一座更大的圖書館，議會後來同意了。她還說，每個人都有隱私權，所以市政府會好好保護大家的資料。議會也和警方合作，保護城市不受犯罪和恐怖行動的威脅。最後，老師指派兩位同學寫一份報告。我朋友開玩笑說寫報告是一種懲罰，但其實很好玩。

questions.questionZh: 很久以前，學生為什麼走到市政府？
options: 覺得學校的午餐太難吃了
希望公園能開放到半夜

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："Last month, our city council wanted to put cameras in every park. The plan was very controversial. Some people said the cameras would help stop crime and even terrorism. But many people were worried about their privacy, and hundreds of them joined a protest in front of the city hall. They said that people should not be watched all the time. In the end, the council appointed a team of experts to study the problem. Anyone who wanted to speak at the next meeting had to register online. My mom registered and gave a short speech. She said that being watched all day feels like a punishment."；改後："Last month, our class visited the city hall to learn how the city council works. Each of us had to register online before the visit. A council member showed us an old map of the city. She told us about a famous protest long ago: some students walked to the city hall to ask for a bigger library, and the council agreed. She also said that everyone has a right to privacy, so the city keeps people's information safe. The council works with the police to keep the city safe from crime and terrorism, too. At the end, our teacher appointed two students to write a report. My friend joked that writing a report was a punishment, but it was fun."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："上個月，我們的市議會想在每座公園裝攝影機。這個計畫非常有爭議。有些人說攝影機能幫忙防止犯罪，甚至是恐怖行動。但很多人擔心自己的隱私，好幾百人在市政府前參加了抗議活動。他們說，人們不該一直被監視。最後，議會任命了一個專家小組研究這個問題。想在下次會議發言的人都必須上網登記。我媽媽登記了，還做了一段簡短的演講。她說，整天被監視感覺就像在受懲罰。"；改後："上個月，我們班去參觀市政府，了解市議會怎麼運作。參觀前，每個人都要先上網登記。一位議員給我們看了一張城市的老地圖。她跟我們說了很久以前一場有名的抗議：一群學生走到市政府，要求蓋一座更大的圖書館，議會後來同意了。她還說，每個人都有隱私權，所以市政府會好好保護大家的資料。議會也和警方合作，保護城市不受犯罪和恐怖行動的威脅。最後，老師指派兩位同學寫一份報告。我朋友開玩笑說寫報告是一種懲罰，但其實很好玩。"
